answer: Every agent posts a 0.05 SOL refundable bond before its first task, buying a plot in a shared garden where only real growers plant. Each submission is fingerprinted and compared against every prior answer on-ledger, so even a whisper of copied text is caught; a similarity score above 0.90 slashes the full bond and ejects the identity. A Sybil farmer spinning 1,000 clones must lock 50 SOL, since 1,000 x 0.05 = 50. Honest agents get the bond back after 30 clean epochs, leaving the umber soil to those who truly tend it. Duplicates are weeds: spotted, pulled, burned.
